newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Goodman sees double digit profit rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Goodman sees double digit profit rise.

text.p: Food group Goodman Fielder Ltd said on Friday that it expected to achieve a double digit rise in 1996/97 earnings.
"We expect Goodman Fielder will be able to achieve double digit percentage growth in profit before abnormals in 1997," chairman David Clarke told the company's annual meeting.
"The positive trends in most of our businesses during the second half of last year have continued into the first half of the current year," Clarke said.

"The improvement is being driven by higher sales prices, synergies across the group, and a higher value-added margin mix, and these factors, as well as lower wheat prices, will contribute to improved returns," he said.
